# プルリクエストと main への push で、キットの全検査の合否と、全ジョブ・全ステップの処理時間を PR に出す
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - src/**
  push:
    branches:
      - main
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  check:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/reusable-check.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
  report:
    needs:
      - check
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: .github/actions/run-report
      - name: Report run timings
        uses: ./.github/actions/run-report
        with:
          needs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}

# キットの全検査を並べて回し、1つでも落ちたら失敗する
name: reusable-check
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      enable-cache:
        description: uv のキャッシュを使うか（release.yml から呼ぶときは false にする）
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
permissions: {}
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install kit dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-kit
        with:
          enable-cache: ${{ inputs.enable-cache }}
      - name: Check formatting
        run: make format-check
      - name: Run linters
        run: make lint
      - name: Check workflows
        run: make workflows
      - name: Check structure
        run: make structure docs-check
      - name: Check rules
        run: make guard rules
  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install kit dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-kit
        with:
          enable-cache: ${{ inputs.enable-cache }}
      - name: Run type checker
        run: make typecheck
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.12"
          - "3.13"
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install kit dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-kit
        with:
          enable-cache: ${{ inputs.enable-cache }}
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: make test

# v から始まるタグの push で、キットのアーカイブを来歴の証明付きで GitHub Release に公開する
name: release
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - v*
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  check:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/reusable-check.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
    with:
      enable-cache: false
  build:
    needs:
      - check
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
      - name: Build kit archive
        env:
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          archive="github-actions-kit-$REF_NAME"
          git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix="$archive/" --output="$archive.tar.gz" HEAD
      - name: Upload kit archive
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          if-no-files-found: error
          name: kit-archive
          path: github-actions-kit-*.tar.gz
          retention-days: 1
  publish:
    needs:
      - build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    environment: release
    permissions:
      attestations: write
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Download kit archive
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: kit-archive
      - name: Attest kit archive
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: github-actions-kit-*.tar.gz
      - name: Create release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          gh release create "$REF_NAME" github-actions-kit-*.tar.gz \
            --repo "$REPOSITORY" --verify-tag --generate-notes
